mapper.sql:
tn.id AS task_node_id, tn.task_id, tn.node_id AS current_node_id, tn.node_name, tn.node_type, tn.handle_time AS handle_time, t.task_name, t.template_id, t.create_time AS task_create_time, tpl.template_name,
COALESCE(dn.node_tips, n.node_tips) AS node_tips, COALESCE(dn.next_handler_tip, n.next_handler_tip) AS next_handler_tip,
d.id AS dispatch_id, d.period_name, d.period_no, d.start_time AS period_start_time, d.end_time AS period_end_time,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM flow_task_node p WHERE p.task_id = tn.task_id AND p.handler_user_id = #{handlerUserId} AND p.submit_status = 0 ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS todo_status
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT tn.task_id FROM flow_task_node tn INNER JOIN flow_task t ON tn.task_id = t.id WHERE tn.handler_user_id = #{handlerUserId} AND t.status IN ('进行中', '已结束') GROUP BY tn.task_id ) sub

SELECT COALESCE(d.task_id, t.id) AS taskId, COALESCE(plan.task_name, t.task_name) AS taskName, COALESCE(plan.template_id, t.template_id) AS templateId, COALESCE(tpl.template_name, tpl2.template_name) AS templateName, COALESCE(plan.create_time, t.create_time) AS taskCreateTime, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.id, t.id)) AS periodCount, SUM(CASE WHEN tn.submit_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount FROM flow_task_node tn INNER JOIN flow_task t ON tn.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN flow_task_dispatch d ON d.id = t.dispatch_id LEFT JOIN flow_dispatch plan ON plan.id = d.task_id LEFT JOIN flow_template tpl ON plan.template_id = tpl.id LEFT JOIN flow_template tpl2 ON t.template_id = tpl2.id WHERE tn.handler_user_id = #{handlerUserId} AND t.status IN ('进行中', '已结束')
AND COALESCE(plan.task_name, t.task_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%')
GROUP BY COALESCE(d.task_id, t.id), COALESCE(plan.task_name, t.task_name), COALESCE(plan.template_id, t.template_id), tpl.template_name, tpl2.template_name, COALESCE(plan.create_time, t.create_time)
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tn.submit_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
> 0 = 0
ORDER BY COALESCE(plan.create_time, t.create_time) DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(d.task_id, t.id) AS taskId FROM flow_task_node tn INNER JOIN flow_task t ON tn.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN flow_task_dispatch d ON d.id = t.dispatch_id LEFT JOIN flow_dispatch plan ON plan.id = d.task_id WHERE tn.handler_user_id = #{handlerUserId} AND t.status IN ('进行中', '已结束')
AND COALESCE(plan.task_name, t.task_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%')
GROUP BY COALESCE(d.task_id, t.id)
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tn.submit_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
> 0 = 0
) sub

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.task_id, t.id)) AS taskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tn.submit_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingNodeCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tn.submit_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS doneNodeCount FROM flow_task_node tn INNER JOIN flow_task t ON tn.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN flow_task_dispatch d ON d.id = t.dispatch_id WHERE tn.handler_user_id = #{handlerUserId} AND t.status IN ('进行中', '已结束')

SELECT tn.id AS task_node_id, tn.node_id, tn.node_name, tn.sort_num, tn.node_type, tn.handler_user_id, tn.submit_status, tn.handle_time, tn.next_handler_user_id, tn.form_record_id, tn.action, tn.reject_reason, tn.pass_comment, u.user_name AS handler_name, u2.user_name AS next_handler_name FROM flow_task_node tn LEFT JOIN aut_user u ON tn.handler_user_id = u.yyyt_id LEFT JOIN aut_user u2 ON tn.next_handler_user_id = u2.yyyt_id WHERE tn.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY tn.sort_num ASC
